versions.content: If stringent check is enabled by configuration parameter (FrRxStringentCheck is true), then received data is accepted only if the SlotStatus shows a valid frame (vSS!ValidFrame) and there was no single SlotStatus error bit set (vSS!SyntaxError, vSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation). Otherwise FR_NOT_RECEIVED is written to Fr_RxLPduStatusPtr and 0 is written to Fr_LsduLengthPtr.
